post.description: Answer one question as server-sent events, one `itemSchema` event per frame.

200.description: Server-sent events, one JSON object per `data:` line. The `event` line names the payload: `tool`, `step`, `source`, `token`, `notice`, `answer`, `thread` or `error`. A `: ping` comment line arrives after 15 s of silence; it has no `data:`. `answer` is the last event unless a `thread` or an `error` follows; a client replaces its streamed text with the `answer` event's `text`, never appends it, and takes every link from its `citations[].url`.

search_mode.title: Search Mode
search_mode.description: Hybrid retrieval, or the keyword-only branch during a run.

supported.title: Supported
supported.description: True when every visible claim points at a retrieved source. That is not a verification: sentences under six words and numbers are not checked.

id.title: Id
id.description: The per-answer source alias, such as S1.

CorpusData.title: CorpusData
CorpusData.description: One page: the rows, the cursor for the next page (null at the end) and the match count.

CorpusItemData.title: CorpusItemData
CorpusItemData.description: One row of the table: the facts the columns show, and the API's own basis label.

CorpusItemDetail.title: CorpusItemDetail
CorpusItemDetail.description: The row plus the text, the extras, the history and what was already written about it.

DraftData.title: DraftData
DraftData.description: One saved draft as the list shows it; the detail adds the owner's own words.

DraftDetail.title: DraftDetail
DraftDetail.description: The detail adds the owner's own words, so "Open" shows what the draft was built from.

DraftError.title: DraftError
DraftError.description: A 503 the page can show: which failure, a sentence, and the cap's reset time.

DraftFlagData.title: DraftFlagData
DraftFlagData.description: One numbered note under a draft; `text` is the claim it is about.

FollowupState.title: FollowupState
FollowupState.description: A run waiting between follow-up passes, as `health.followup` records it.

ItemDraftData.title: ItemDraftData
ItemDraftData.description: A draft the item already has, so the page can offer to open it instead of making another.

NoticeData.title: NoticeData
NoticeData.description: The `notice` event: the answer runs in a reduced mode and says so.

RateLimited.title: RateLimited
RateLimited.description: A 429: the per-client limit refused the request before the stream started.

Refusal.title: Refusal
Refusal.description: The body of every gate refusal except 429, as `docs/learn/15` lists them.

RunCounts.title: RunCounts
RunCounts.description: The counts the page reads as six cells; a key the run never counted is 0.

SignalPointData.title: SignalPointData
SignalPointData.description: One observed reading of the item's signals, oldest first in the list.

id.title: Id
id.description: The per-answer source alias, such as S1.

SourceData.title: SourceData
SourceData.description: The `source` event: a source a tool just returned, in alias order.

StatusData.title: StatusData
StatusData.description: `GET /status`: the search mode the page reads on load.

StepData.title: StepData
StepData.description: The `step` event: one tool round finished.

ThreadData.title: ThreadData
ThreadData.description: The `thread` event: the finished turn was stored, so the client can follow up.

ThreadDetailData.title: ThreadDetailData
ThreadDetailData.description: One conversation with every finished turn, oldest first.

ThreadSummaryData.title: ThreadSummaryData
ThreadSummaryData.description: One conversation in the Recent menu: its name and how many turns it holds.

ThreadTurnData.title: ThreadTurnData
ThreadTurnData.description: One finished turn as the page re-renders it after a dropped stream.

TierChangeData.title: TierChangeData
TierChangeData.description: One move in the item's tier history.

TokenData.title: TokenData
TokenData.description: The `token` event: a piece of the model's answer, before the citation check.

ToolData.title: ToolData
ToolData.description: The `tool` event: the model called one of the corpus tools.

VercelOidcOrHmac.description: A Vercel OIDC token, or an HMAC token from `paperwatch api-token --live`.
